name: <namespace>/accordion
title: Accordion
description: Heading and questions; one answer open at a time.

description.default: Open one question — the one that was open closes.

default.title: Where does data get cleaned?
default.body: In block.php, with WordPress sanitization functions. The Blade view only prints.

default.title: How does the accordion open?
default.body: Native details elements that share a name, so opening one closes the others. No JavaScript.

default.title: How do I reorder the items?
default.body: Drag them, or use the arrows, in the Items list in the block sidebar.
